test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 26 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LO-MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc5715a3b347fd6875afc10a394d58446ed37cce739f2faae04213f7289d60e4.png] 

Option 2) SW-UY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84c5b245eb74c0c3c9f5b761922b864c7c35081f52ece8736abb928c424ee810.png] 

Option 3) TW-UX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/644b34280a321c434a21275fa86f4ce6a13e88406507ce08b96c473c0366d77e.png] 

Option 4) CF-DG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88cd0bb7c3127643dbbae0ed0edc0ff1205c784a67767a157938c486b3da4bb4.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'SW-UY' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
